scope: Unadopted specialized name-presentation repair. Actual DAE Aeneas emission passes; Lean admission fails. No new UD relation or golden admission.

claims.claim: Two valid native/Charon source fixtures reproduce both actual DAE naming failures; candidate emits and Lean accepts both.
Default-body comparison laws and payload laws pass over generated code with guarded axiom inventories.
Actual source mutation fails native and unchanged Lean laws; concrete wrong answer is established.
Ordinary constructor/method, unspecialized default and prior impl outputs are byte-identical to predecessor controls.
Explicit namespace changes the intended noncolliding method and call; same payload law passes.
Deliberate duplicate names still refuse. Specialized constructor-function interpreter failure remains and is not admitted.
Actual DAE emits with Aeneas status0 and six library-field warnings, then Lean refuses with21 diagnostics.
Lean root-error groups are iterator/exact-size library fields, F64 universe inference and phantom-type inference, with downstream fallout; root causes require separate source reductions.
Prepared-name conversion preserves specialization generally; no general injectivity/preservation theorem is claimed.
